name: RC Site Manager & Optimization
author: Rocket Comunicazione

sections.description:
Transform your WordPress admin experience with advanced management tools. Optimize WooCommerce product management and statistics, simplified SEO, WP Rocket cache control and media administration from unified dashboards that give you everything at a glance within reach.

Save hours of daily admin work by eliminating the need to jump between multiple plugin interfaces. Get instant access to critical WooCommerce sales data, SEO status updates, cache performance metrics, and media library insights from centralized dashboards. Perfect for busy store owners, developers, and digital agencies who need efficient site management without the complexity.

Languages

English, Italian, French, German, Dutch, Spanish

Smart Integration System

The plugin automatically detects and enhances your existing tools, providing deep integration with:

WooCommerce Integration
* Simplified product and category management
* Advanced order and customer statistics
* Annual analytics and sales reporting
* Custom reporting dashboard

SEO Tools Integration
* Rank Math – Simplified and enhanced SEO management interface
* Yoast SEO – Quick edit SEO data from custom panels
* Unified SEO dashboard for both plugins
* Bulk SEO operations
* Quick meta editing

WP Rocket Integration
* Activation rules for total or partial cache cleanup
* Automatic daily and hourly scheduling
* Cache performance monitoring
* Quick regeneration of failed or incomplete cache

Multilingual Compatibility
* Automatic recognition of WPML/Polylang content
* Language-aware dashboards for statistics and content

Core Features

Centralized Dashboards
All your site management tools in one place. Dashboards give you everything at a glance within reach with instant access to critical functions and real-time statistics.

Media Management
* Advanced media library tools
* Bulk operations
* Image optimization utilities

Top URL Tracking
Monitor your most important pages with custom tracking. Perfect for tracking landing pages, campaigns, and high-value content.

Utility Tools
Collection of powerful utilities for daily admin tasks:
* Bulk operations
* System information
* Performance monitoring

Existing Plugin Enhancement
Doesn’t interfere with your plugins but enhances their functionality with simplified interfaces and additional controls not available in standard WordPress.

Technical Excellence

  • Performance First: Optimized code with minimal overhead
  • Security: Admin-only access with proper capability checks
  • Database: Custom tables for efficient data storage
  • AJAX Powered: Smooth, no-refresh operations
  • Fully Translatable: Complete internationalization support
  • Clean Code: Following WordPress coding standards

Perfect For

  • Digital Agencies managing multiple client sites
  • E-commerce Stores running WooCommerce
  • Content Publishers needing advanced SEO tools
  • Developers wanting efficient admin workflows
  • Site Administrators seeking time-saving tools

Why Choose RC Site Manager?

  1. One Plugin, Multiple Solutions – Avoid tons of additional code for customizations
  2. Intelligent Integration – Works with your existing tools, not against them
  3. Time Efficiency – Reduce admin time by up to 70%
  4. Professional Grade – Built by agency developers for real-world use
  5. Active Development – Regular updates and new features
  6. Clean Backend – No frontend impact, pure admin enhancement

Smart Features

The plugin intelligently adapts based on your installed plugins:
* Shows WooCommerce tools only if WooCommerce is active
* Displays SEO features when Rank Math or Yoast is detected
* Enables WP Rocket panel when the plugin is installed
* Adjusts for WPML/Polylang when multilingual setup is detected

Requirements

  • WooCommerce (version 4.0+)
  • WP Rocket (version 3.8+)
  • Rank Math SEO (version 1.0.90+) OR Yoast SEO (version 19.0+)
  • WPML (version 4.4+) OR Polylang (version 3.2+)

About Rocket Comunicazione

We are a digital agency specializing in WordPress and WooCommerce solutions. With years of experience managing complex sites, we built this plugin to solve real problems we face daily.

Website: rocketcomunicazione.com

Additional Information

Support: Visit our support forum

Privacy: When enabled in Settings, this plugin collects anonymous technical data (WordPress/PHP versions, theme, common plugins) to help improve the plugin. No personal data is collected. This feature can be disabled in User Permissions Settings.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin through WordPress admin
  2. Navigate to ‘RC Site Manager’ in your admin menu
  3. Plugin auto-detects your integrations – you’re ready to go!
sections.faq:
What makes RC Site Manager different from standard WordPress admin?

RC Site Manager performs advanced operations that WordPress, WooCommerce and plugins don’t provide out-of-the-box: deep database analytics, cross-plugin integration management, advanced bulk operations across multiple content types, and sophisticated media tracking with orphan detection. These are complex operations that require custom development and cannot be achieved with standard admin interfaces.

Which plugins does it integrate with?

Currently: WooCommerce, WP Rocket, Rank Math SEO, Yoast SEO, WPML, and Polylang. More integrations coming soon!

Can I use it without WooCommerce?

Absolutely! The plugin adapts to your setup. WooCommerce features only appear if WooCommerce is active.

Will it conflict with other admin tools?

No. We’ve tested compatibility with major admin enhancement plugins and themes.

Can multiple admins use it simultaneously?

Yes, all administrators can access and use the features concurrently.
